All 316 tests pass (217 upstream unchanged + 2 public + 97 own). Updating HANDOFF.md to reflect milestone 2 completion.

{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat > HANDOFF.md << 'EOF'
# cachetools milestone 1 + 2 - TaggedCache

## Status: COMPLETE (public + upstream + own tests all pass)

## Implementation: src/cachetools/tagged.py
- `TaggedCache(maxsize)` wraps private `_TaggedLRUCache(LRUCache)` (1 slot/value).
- R01: `put` validates/dedupes tags FIRST (bare str/bytes, nonstring entries,
  non-iterables -> ValueError) so invalid replacement leaves value/tags/recency
  unchanged; deep-copies value on input. `get` returns detached deep copy,
  KeyError on miss, refreshes recency. `len`/`__contains__`/`maxsize` property.
- R02: `invalidate(tag)` removes exactly live tagged entries, returns count.
  Overwrite removes old tag memberships and refreshes LRU recency (Claim-A).
  LRU evictions recorded via popitem override -> tag maps pruned, no stale
  memberships on key reuse.
- R03: maxsize positive int, bool excluded; invalid replacement preserves
  value/tags/recency; values cost 1 slot.
- R04: `invalidate_many(tags, mode='any')` - 'any' = union, 'all' =
  intersection; empty requested tags -> 0 for either mode; returns distinct
  removed keys; invalid mode/tags raise ValueError before mutation;
  `invalidate(tag)` unchanged.
- R05: `resize(maxsize)` - validates positive non-bool int first (failure
  leaves all state incl. LRU order intact); shrinking evicts LRU-first via
  `_TaggedLRUCache._resize` (sets `_Cache__maxsize` then pops LRU); growing
  never evicts; survivors keep values/tags/LRU order; `maxsize` property
  reports current capacity. (Round-2 expiry clarification: N/A - TaggedCache
  has no expiry state; nothing to drop/recompute.)
- R06: generators accepted, consumed exactly once (full pass in
  `_normalize_tags` before any mutation); returns detached across repeated
  gets/puts incl. nested lists/dicts (deepcopy both directions).
- Superseded design note ('empty all-tags matches every key; resizing may
  flush') explicitly NOT implemented: empty tags -> 0 removed; resize never
  flushes beyond LRU shrink.

## Tests
- tests/test_tagged.py: 97 tests (R01/R02/R02-ext/R03/R04/R05/R06/edges).
- Public acceptance_public.py: 2 passed.
- Upstream tests/: 217 passed, unchanged (only new untracked files added).

Run: `PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q`
EOF
echo updated"}
